'''Walking Pig Heads''' are the [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Pig|Assimilated Pigs]].

==''Spawning''==
* Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Pig dies.
* Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Walking Pig Heads are cowardly Melee swarm units.
* Walking Pig Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Pig Heads can perform small leaps.
* They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Pigs.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Pig Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Walking Pig Heads are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Pig Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Walking Pig Heads will run away during the daytime if no other Parasites are present.
